lines.text: A song. A Psalm of David.
My heart is steadfast, O God;
I will sing and make music with all my being.
Awake, O harp and lyre!
I will awaken the dawn.
I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations;
I will sing Your praises among the peoples.
For Your loving devotion extends beyond the heavens,
and Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
Be exalted, O God, above the heavens;
may Your glory cover all the earth.
Respond and save us with Your right hand,
that Your beloved may be delivered.
God has spoken from His sanctuary:
“I will triumph!
I will parcel out Shechem
and apportion the Valley of Succoth.
Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine;
Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.
Moab is My washbasin;
upon Edom I toss My sandal;
over Philistia I shout in triumph.”
Who will bring me to the fortified city?
Who will lead me to Edom?
Have You not rejected us, O God?
Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?
Give us aid against the enemy,
for the help of man is worthless.
With God we will perform with valor,
and He will trample our enemies.

pictures.name: pd_domenichino_david

pictures.scene: Matthias Grünewald, Concert of Angels — the viols bowed and the angels singing, making music with all their being
pictures.name: pd_grunewald_engelkonzert

pictures.scene: Frederic Edwin Church, Morning in the Tropics — the sun coming up over the still river, I will awaken the dawn
pictures.name: pd_church_morning

pictures.scene: Sandro Botticelli, Mystic Nativity — the ring of angels dancing over the stable, and men and angels embracing below
pictures.name: pd_botticelli_nativita

pictures.scene: John Constable, Salisbury Cathedral from the Meadows — the rainbow standing over the spire in the storm, His faithfulness reaching to the clouds
pictures.name: pd_constable_salisbury

pictures.scene: Thomas Moran, The Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone — the light pouring down the whole length of the canyon, may Your glory cover all the earth
pictures.name: pd_moran_yellowstone

pictures.scene: Domenico Ghirlandaio, The Angel Appearing to Zacharias — the angel at the altar of incense, God has spoken from His sanctuary
pictures.name: pd_ghirlandaio_zaccaria

pictures.scene: Claude Lorrain, Jacob with Laban and his Daughters — the shepherd bargaining for his portion of the land and the flocks, I will parcel out Shechem
pictures.name: pd_lorrain_jacob

pictures.scene: James Tissot, The Caravan of Abram — the whole household and its flocks winding down into the valley, Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine
pictures.name: pd_tissot_caravan

pictures.scene: Circle of Rembrandt, The Man with the Golden Helmet — the helmet catching all the light in the dark, Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter
pictures.name: pd_goldhelm

pictures.scene: Nicolas Poussin, The Triumph of David — the head of the Philistine carried through the city with hands lifted on every side, over Philistia I shout in triumph
pictures.name: pd_poussin_david

pictures.scene: David Roberts, El Deir, Petra — the rock-cut fortress in the mountains of Edom, who will lead me to Edom?
pictures.name: pd_roberts_petra

pictures.scene: Eduard Bendemann, Jews Mourning in Exile — the old man in chains with his harp laid down, have You not rejected us, O God?
pictures.name: pd_bendemann_exil

pictures.scene: Nicolas Poussin, The Victory of Joshua over the Amalekites — Moses holding up his hands on the hill above the battle, for the help of man is worthless
pictures.name: pd_poussin_amalek

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, Christ in Limbo — the Lord entering with the banner of the cross, standing on the broken door with the enemy crushed beneath it
pictures.name: pd_angelico_limbo
